description: Perched above the Burrard Inlet, this architect-designed West Vancouver home pairs walls of glass with warm oak millwork. The open-concept main floor flows to a cantilevered deck framing sweeping ocean and mountain views, while the chef's kitchen anchors effortless indoor-outdoor entertaining. A private primary suite occupies its own wing, and a walk-out lower level offers a media room and guest suite.

A sun-filled corner residence in one of Lower Lonsdale's most sought-after towers. Floor-to-ceiling windows capture harbour and city views from every room, while the wraparound balcony extends the living space outdoors. Steps to the SeaBus, Shipyards District, and Lonsdale Quay Market.

A beautifully updated family home on a quiet, tree-lined street in Lynn Valley. The main floor offers a bright great room layout opening to a landscaped, fully fenced backyard, while a legal two-bedroom suite provides excellent mortgage-helper flexibility. Top-rated catchment schools and Lynn Valley Village are minutes away.

Modern loft-style living in the heart of Central Lonsdale. This bright two-bedroom home features polished concrete accents, an efficient galley kitchen, and a private balcony overlooking a landscaped courtyard. Cafés, transit, and Waterfront Park are all within a five-minute walk.

A commanding Deep Cove-area estate with unobstructed views over Indian Arm. Soaring ceilings and a dramatic staircase set the tone for a home built for entertaining, with a wine room, home theatre, and resort-style pool deck. Six bedrooms across three levels suit multi-generational living.

A rare end-unit townhome in a boutique West Vancouver complex, offering a private garden patio and rooftop deck with ocean glimpses. The main level's open plan and gas fireplace make for easy everyday living, with a double garage and extra storage below.
